dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending across the shoulders and occupying approximately 35% of the visible torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation with ears positioned on the upper outer quadrants of the cranium.

other_distinctive_markers: Noticeable yellowish-brown discoloration of the white fur in the sub-mandibular and ventral neck regions.
